_comment: GENERATED limit table for the size ratchet in src/cadrumo/tests/test_codebase_size_budgets.py. Do NOT hand-edit the 'modules' or 'callables' numbers: regenerate with `python -m dev.audit.size_budget --write-baseline`, then review and commit the diff. Every limit is a measured size plus a declared headroom, and the gate fails BOTH when an entry grows past its limit and when a limit drifts further above its subject than the declared slack tolerance, so a pin cannot silently outlive the size it was taken from. 'notes' is the one hand-maintained section: prose only, never numbers, carried forward verbatim across regeneration and dropped when its key disappears. Keys are repo-relative POSIX paths, and 'path::function' for callables.

notes.src/cadrumo/adapters/persistence/storage: The raw-row decode/fault-isolation codec is already extracted to _secure_object_row_codec.py. The core-complexity decomposition split the remaining hotspot callables into named helpers, so the residual size is helper signatures and docstrings; radon reports no callable above C.
notes.src/cadrumo/application/auth/_operator.p: Authentication lifecycle responsibilities. The auth decomposition split its complexity hotspots into named private helpers; radon reports no callable above C here.
notes.src/cadrumo/application/bucket_maintenan: The _delete_locked decomposition split this into named private helpers; the only callable radon still rates C is import_.
notes.src/cadrumo/application/ledger/_actions_: Split direction: extract the manual-command helpers.
notes.src/cadrumo/application/user_profile/_cu: A resolver dispatch table; the length is table rows rather than branching.
notes.src/cadrumo/application/workflow/_engine: The workflow decomposition extracted the engine's stage helpers into named private callables.
notes.src/cadrumo/core/config.py: The split-by-mixin direction is proven rather than theoretical: extracting the LLM and MCP-serving settings into mixins already took a substantial slice off this module. Split direction: continue that mixin extraction.
notes.src/cadrumo/domain/calculations/registry: Data-shaped growth: the M143/M156/M185/M186/M490/M604/M763/M848 applicability-rule table. Split direction: extract the rule table into per-family submodules on the next applicability pass.

The IRNR/M210 formula-op evaluator family was extracted to _formula_runtime_irnr.py and the shared error types plus numeric accessor to _formula_runtime_ops.py (registry-resolver-family-extraction). Split direction: further formula-op families remain extractable the same way.
Load-bearing registry compiler; the locale-translation load/merge/inject pipeline was already extracted to _loader_locales.py. Split direction: owner pass rather than a same-pass extraction.
Not acquired complexity: the ruff 0.15.22 -> 0.16.0 formatter reflow joined comprehensions and call chains the old formatter split. A split would be the wrong remedy here.
Carries a sys.platform guard so ty resolves winreg only on win32.
notes.src/cadrumo/entrypoints/cli/_ledger.py::: A wide Typer signature (manual + LLM + saturate + evidence + auto-split routes). The LLM-routing bodies live in _ledger_llm_cli.py; what remains is the option surface and the route dispatch.
notes.src/cadrumo/entrypoints/cli/_ledger_read: Split direction: the invoice link/verify read surface is the extractable family.
notes.src/cadrumo/entrypoints/cli/_modelo_payl: The bindings list/resolve payload family was extracted to _modelo_bindings_payloads.py, following the split pattern of _modelo_aux_payloads.py and _modelo_revision_payload_parts.py.
notes.src/cadrumo/entrypoints/mcp/_server.py::: MCP SDK handler-registration factory: every @server.list_tools() / @server.call_tool() handler closes over server, window, and the persona/telemetry gates built earlier in the function, so the handlers cannot be hoisted to module level without threading that state through every handler signature. Split direction: extract the per-capability handler-builder closures (tools/prompts/resources) into factory helpers taking the shared state as arguments.
